flags.name: Splitting matters: static either loses at least half the economy ships it built to raids or fails to take the hive within the cap, and adaptive takes the hive
flags.detail: static/1 (war-lean 2/1/3/2/3) timeout, lost 15 of 25 economy ships ok; static/2 (war-lean 2/1/3/2/3) timeout, lost 15 of 25 economy ships ok; static/3 (war-lean 2/1/3/2/3) timeout, lost 15 of 25 economy ships ok; adaptive/1 won, adaptive/2 won, adaptive/3 won

flags.name: Greed is answered by raids: greedy's first hitting raid kills at least 2 economy ships, and greedy still wins after responding
flags.detail: greedy/1 first hit killed 2, won ok; greedy/2 first hit killed 2, won ok; greedy/3 first hit killed 2, won ok

flags.name: Waiting is safe: idle is raided at most once
flags.detail: idle/1 raids mustered 1 (hit 1, beaten 0, turned back 0) ok; idle/2 raids mustered 1 (hit 1, beaten 0, turned back 0) ok; idle/3 raids mustered 1 (hit 1, beaten 0, turned back 0) ok

flags.name: The counter-attack window is real: the hive's smallest winning wave with a full-size raid out is at least 30% smaller than at full strength
flags.detail: best mix at full strength 16; with a raid of 4 Thorns and 8 Spores out 11

flags.name: Counters matter: drones-only can't take the hive within field.fleetCap minus 10 economy ships (its best drone wave doesn't fit)
flags.detail: smallest drone wave none within 30 against 20 warship slots (field.fleetCap 30 minus 10)

flags.name: Economy against offence is a trade in slots: the hive's best mix plus a full economy is more than field.fleetCap, and the best mix plus 10 economy ships fits
flags.detail: best mix 16; full economy 21 (13 Mine slots plus 8 haulers at adaptive's peak); field.fleetCap 30; best mix + full economy = 37, best mix + 10 = 26

flags.name: No free first win: every guarded node needs more drones than the opening stock buys
flags.detail: p1 needs more than 3 drones (2 buyable from the opening stock) ok; p2 needs more than 3 drones (2 buyable from the opening stock) ok; heart needs more than 3 drones (2 buyable from the opening stock) ok
